title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29643: enable split transfer demand profiles
summary: Transfer demand profile handling now supports an event that allows extensions to create multiple profiles for different planning contexts, such as preserving distinct cable and cut-length requirements instead of aggregating quantities.
key_points: New pre-creation event added to MaintainPlanningLine for transfer demand profiles
Event provides requisition, supply profile, tracking reservation, line-number, and handled context
Enables downstream purchase suggestions to maintain separate length requirements
Standard behavior preserved when no subscriber handles the event
Extensions can now safely override default transfer planning flow
quote: adds a take-over event with tracking context and shared line-number state so extensions can create multiple demand profiles
